implementation:
Frozen NF4 projections and their complete nested quantization state stay in pinned host memory. Two fixed GPU U8 slabs receive the requested weight bytes on every lease, protected by ready/last-reader events and a host version check.

For each weight and slot, a bounded cache reuses QuantState metadata and typed Tensor views of that same slab. Each slot keeps at most512entries. This removes repeated Python/Tensor view construction while keeping the same two GPU storage buffers and the original native bitsandbytes math. Once full, the cache builds a view without retaining another entry.

Saved activations from the first20decoder layers are offloaded; eight late layers remain resident. The frozen vocabulary head streams through its own bounded buffers. The full Kaggle suite includes the new native NF4 forward/input-gradient parity test at scales1/1024/65536, repeated slot reuse, exact two-slab aliasing and rejection of a modified nested host state.
